the malformed id is rejected by `parseId`

findings.text: parseId accepts ids up to 9999999999, but specialization.id is a serial (int4) column. An id such as 3000000000 reaches refStatus, Postgres raises out-of-range, and the route answers 500 instead of 404. The review says malformed ids are fully handled.
